policy: Limits are ratchets. Lower them after reductions; raise them only with an explicit context-budget justification.
adjustment_justification: The CUDA throughput follow-up adds 1,414 production tokens for execution-specific reductions, validation eligibility metadata, a one-entry PTX cache, and command lifecycle timing. The frozen public source generator remains unchanged. Observation generation and tick timing were split into focused modules; CUDA and CLI file-size ratchets and the largest-function ratchet decrease. CPU, runtime, and IR budgets are unchanged; independent CPU edits are excluded from this benchmark candidate.
